composition: Twin-towered Puglian Romanesque cathedral rising from the Adriatic waterfront harbor · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From across the water, the camera frames Molfetta Cathedral rising above the harbor in the bright 12:30 midday sun. The twin towers of the pale Romanesque cathedral dominate the center, flanked by the whitewashed houses of the old town, while the marina with its moored boats fills the lower left and the blue Adriatic stretches to the horizon. The pale stonework glows against the clear blue sky, the whole waterfront scene bathed in high daylight.
